strategies.name: EDITREF_TEST
strategies.sourceXml:
<Strategy name="EDITREF_TEST" version="1" wireValue="EDITREFTEST" uiRep="EditRefTest" providerID="SIMULATOR" xmlns="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Core">
    <val:Edit id="DurationIsZero" field="c_Duration" operator="EQ" value="0" xmlns:val="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Validation" />
    <Parameter name="Duration" xsi:type="Int_t" fixTag="7001" use="optional" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" />

    <lay:StrategyLayout xmlns:lay="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Layout">
      <lay:StrategyPanel title="EditRef Test" orientation="VERTICAL" collapsible="false">
        <lay:Control ID="c_Duration" xsi:type="lay:TextField_t" parameterRef="Duration" label="Duration" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
          <flow:StateRule enabled="false" xmlns:flow="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Flow">
            <val:EditRef id="DurationIsZero" xmlns:val="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Validation" />
          </flow:StateRule>
        </lay:Control>
      </lay:StrategyPanel>
    </lay:StrategyLayout>
  </Strategy>
